# Remindly PRD (synthetic)

## Requirements
| ID | Requirement | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| REQ-1 | Send a reminder 3 days before an invoice is due | P0 |
| REQ-2 | Stop reminders once the invoice is paid | P0 |
| REQ-3 | Let the customer pick email or SMS | P1 |
| REQ-4 | Draft reminder text with AI, from fixed templates only | P1 |

Out of scope: collections. See also REQ-2 for the paid webhook.
